open_points.subject: M28 Installation change application
open_points.text: "the configuration is read at start; the token list is read again whenever it has changed" and "manifest_location, manifest_revision ... read by every manifest reading (M10), so a record changes for the kernel only when the owner changes the configured revision"
open_points.question: Do non-token installation changes (especially manifest revision, service instances, credentials) take effect only after restart, or are they reloaded at runtime?
options: All installation fields are fixed after process start; only token list hot-reloads
Manifest-related fields hot-reload, other fields require restart
open_points.default_guess: Only token list hot-reloads; all other installation changes require restart.

open_points.subject: M13 FlowVersion identity vs authorship fields
open_points.text: "flow_version_id: derived from flow_id, inputs, outputs, nodes, edges and constants" with candidate fields including "authored_by, authored_at"
open_points.question: If an agent composes flow content identical to an existing FlowVersion, is the existing version reused, and if so which authored_by/authored_at are kept?
options: Reuse existing FlowVersion and keep first-authored metadata
Reuse existing FlowVersion and update/append authorship metadata
Always create a new FlowVersion record despite equal content
open_points.default_guess: Reuse existing FlowVersion and keep the first stored authored_by/authored_at.

open_points.subject: Run action refusal before start
open_points.text: Primary action "run a flow" failure: "a function node whose contract version has no current activation refuses the start"
open_points.question: When start is refused, is any Run (M19) or NodeExecution trace record created, or is the call refused with no run record?
options: No Run is created; refusal is only the action result
Create a Run immediately in final status (failed/refused) with trace
Create a Run in pending/running then end it as failed
open_points.default_guess: No Run is created; start refusal returns without persisting a run.
